name: Marcus Vance
description: Angry father in Ohio dealing with an ex-spouse refusing court-ordered weekend visitation.
style: bitter, irritable, vents personal grievances against ex-wife
quirks: Constantly criticizes his ex-wife's new boyfriend
Uses legal terms incorrectly ('she violated my constitutional rights')
Needs to be gently steered back to visitation schedule details

hidden_case.goal: Enforce court-ordered weekend parenting time and custody agreement
facts: Divorce finalized in Franklin County, Ohio in 2024
Decree grants father alternate weekend parenting time with 7-year-old son
Mother refused custody hand-off on last two consecutive scheduled weekends
timeline: Jan 2024: Final divorce decree and parenting plan entered
Oct 10: Mother refused to open door for Friday 5 PM pickup
Oct 24: Mother blocked father's calls and took child out of town
documents: Text messages from mother refusing visitation
deadlines: Nov 7: Next scheduled alternate weekend visitation
